name: perl-class-trigger
description: Class::Trigger is a Perl mixin that allows developers to define and execute inheritable callback hooks within class methods. Use when user asks to add trigger points to a class, register callbacks for specific events, or create extensible Perl frameworks with abortable hooks.
overview: Class::Trigger is a lightweight mixin for Perl that enables "hooks" or "triggers" within a class. It allows developers to define specific points in a method where external code (callbacks) can be executed. These triggers are inheritable by subclasses and can be applied globally to a class or specifically to an individual object instance. This module is particularly useful for creating extensible frameworks where users need to "plug in" logic before, during, or after standard operations.
